empty.hint: Ask in plain language, then follow up on its answers. It answers from general knowledge, not from the tickets.

stopped: Stopped before the answer was complete.

errors.rate-limited: Too many questions at once. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.unavailable: The chat is not available right now. Try again later.
errors.personal-data-blocked: The chat did not send this question: the conversation holds personal data that must not reach the model, such as a card number. Remove it from the question and ask again, or start a new conversation if an earlier answer holds it.
errors.failed: The chat could not answer this question.
errors.request: The question could not be sent.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: How the chat picks its model and how its traces reach Phoenix.

model.title: Model
model.sentence: Every chat question goes to this LiteLLM alias; litellm/config.yaml maps it to a provider model.
model.notLoaded: The models could not be loaded.

traces.title: App traces to Phoenix
traces.onSentence: On: the app also sends its own spans, and each question shows as one trace with the app's spans and LiteLLM's model calls.
traces.offSentence: Off: only LiteLLM sends traces, one per model call, with the provider model and its cost but without the app's spans.

join.title: Group LiteLLM calls per chat message
join.onSentence: On: LiteLLM's calls for one chat message share one trace even while app traces are off. The app's spans never arrive then, so Phoenix lists each call as a row of its own within that trace.
join.offSentence: Off: while app traces are off, each LiteLLM call is a trace of its own.
join.lockedSentence: App traces already group each question into one trace, so this applies again only while they are off.

llmSpans.title: App LLM traces to Phoenix
llmSpans.onSentence: On: the app's span of a model call is an LLM span with the call's tokens, so a question's trace counts each call's tokens twice, beside LiteLLM's span.
llmSpans.offSentence: Off: the app's span of a model call is a plain step, so each call's tokens and cost are counted once, on LiteLLM's span.
llmSpans.lockedSentence: The app sends no spans while app traces are off, so this applies only while they are on.

appToLitellm.asWritten: Questions as the users wrote them, names and other personal data included.

appToPhoenix.asWritten: The app's spans, personal data included.

litellmToPresidio.sent: Every request, before it goes to the provider: LiteLLM's guardrail.

litellmToProvider.namesAsWritten: Names as written. The guardrail masks e-mail addresses, phone numbers, IBANs and PESELs, and a card number refuses the request.

litellmToPhoenix.sent: Each model call, as the provider received it.

shapes.perQuestionWithSteps: One trace per question: the app's spans with LiteLLM's model calls.
shapes.perQuestionModelCalls: One trace per question, holding LiteLLM's model calls only.
shapes.perModelCall: One trace per model call, from LiteLLM only.
